item.title: Josh Hubbard named to All-SEC team for third straight season
item.description: Josh Hubbard is Mississippi’s lone representative in this year’s SEC postseason awards. The star Mississippi State guard was a third-team selection in the all-conference team that was announced on Monday. Hubbard is joined by former NBA journeyman Erick Dampier as the only Bulldog players to notch All-SEC status during their freshman, sophomore, and junior campaigns. […]

item.title: T&L Extra: Coach Brian O’Connor Joins SportsTalk Mississippi As SEC Play Begins
item.description: Mississippi State will put the finishing touches on the non-conference portion of the schedule Tuesday night, then will head to Arkansas to begin the gauntlet of SEC play. Coach Brian O’Connor joins Brian Hadad to discuss his team and their successful start to the 2026 season.
